# Transition IV: The Weight of Tomorrow

The house on Cedar Street was painted the color of weak tea, and it sat on a lot that sloped gently toward the street, which meant that every spring the meltwater ran across the yard and pooled against the foundation in ways that the previous owner had apparently considered acceptable.
